audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].why, phases[5].why and phases[6].why all describe Sion-owned windows sitting under Gwen-owned rows — phases[5] literally says 'Heartsteel is your spike, force fights the moment it completes' on the row where the content layer says Riftmaker flips the lane against you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hallowed Mist is described five times as 'blocking your charged Q stun', full stop — as if it were an immunity. It is a stationary zone that only makes her untargetable to enemies OUTSIDE it, and no field tells the player the counterplay: walk in.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.' Standing inside the mist restores your ability to hit her — for a melee champion whose whole pattern is a charged swing, that is the single most useful sentence in the matchup, and it was missing. The mist is also 22/21/20/19/18, never quoted. Skip 'n Slash is 13s at rank 1 with a partial refund when it connects, and applies on-hit effects. A Thousand Cuts heals her off every auto, so Grievous Wounds — mentioned only as a generic line in the itemization report — belongs in the wants.
audit.corrected: wants.you[0] rewritten to 'step inside the mist'; wants.foe[0] and whys[2] given the 22s and the outside-only condition; wants.you[2] made the anti-heal line; Skip 'n Slash's refund and Needlework's 120s added.

Nothing in Sion's fields here states the wrong resistance, but 'Build MR' in dosFull[1] is aimed at her magic damage and is fine — note that Snip Snip!'s centre is true damage, so MR does not cover the part of her kit the tldr calls '%HP shreds you'.
